thread:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release v2026.03.15.3 -> prod (canary 10%). logs: https://ci/release/2765432099 :rocket: 
incident-bot: 🚨 Alerts firing: prod.gateway.p99_latency up 4x, prod.gateway.5xx_rate up 3.2x, customer-facing timeouts increasing. Pager sent to neo.
neo: I'm on it. Paging details?
jamal: grafana: https://grafana/board/xy - p95 from 120ms -> 1.6s, p99 -> 3.8s since 1m after canary. 504s showing from edge-gw.
sara: seeing a cluster of 502/504 from the gateway layer, backend service (inference-proxy) mostly 200s. Could be connection churn at the gateway.
alex: fwiw the deploy touched gateway keepalive tuning (PR #4052) - lowered keepalive idle to 10s for faster sock cleanup.
lisa: that change went only to canary 10% right? Correct.
jamal: yes canary 10%. But error rate jumps correlate with canary hosts.
neo: run quick health checks and tcpdump on canary gateway host, + tail proxy logs.
kevin: running tcpdump for host gw-canary-07, filtering RST/FIN.
kevin: output snippet: ```
12:03:41.123456 IP gw-canary-07 > backend-12: Flags [R.], seq 0, ack 1, win 0
12:03:41.123457 IP gw-canary-07 > backend-12: Flags [RST], seq 1, ack 0
```
sara: proxy logs show repeated socket close after idle 10s: ```
[2026-03-15T12:03:41Z] conn closed idle_timeout=10s remote=10.1.2.12:54321
[2026-03-15T12:03:41Z] upstream request aborted: EOF
```
alex: ok that's the keepalive change biting us. Clients still sending long-lived connections; abrupt closes lead to in-flight requests hitting gateway timeouts.
neo: impact assessment: customer-ops, any reports?
customer-ops: a handful of customers reported degraded responses and retries. No major outage but some latency-sensitive endpoints affected. Tracking 23 customers with >2x error rate in last 5m.
neo: mitigation options: 1) revert keepalive change for canary hosts (fast rollback), 2) bump keepalive back to previous value (config reload), 3) shift canary traffic to older pool. Thoughts?
jamal: quickest is to remove canary from traffic LB. Can we drain gw-canary host group?
lisa: I can remove canary ASG from LB target group now, it'll drain connections -> 60s.
kevin: removing traffic now (aws elb deregister-instances-from-load-balancer).
kevin: command: ```
aws elb deregister-instances-from-load-balancer --load-balancer-name prod-gw-lb --instances i-0cancary07
```
kevin: done. health checker shows decreased requests to canary. Error rate dropping in ~30s.
neo: good. Also start rollback PR for gateway keepalive change so we don't reintroduce on next deploy. alex, file the revert PR please.
alex: filed PR #4070 revert keepalive tuning. Linking: https://git/repo/pull/4070 :white_check_mark:
sara: monitoring: p99 back to baseline in 2m, 5xx rate down. Customers still trending down.
customer-ops: customers notified via status page update: "Intermittent timeouts affecting some customers; root cause identified and mitigated; rolling revert in progress."
incident-bot: severity: high -> lowered to medium after mitigations.
neo: handing off to eng-oncall for postmortem and rollout plan. jamal/sara/alex, please assemble timeline + RCA. I'll follow up with customer-ops for impact details.
jamal: noted. I'll capture metrics and the tcpdump samples.
neo: thanks team. prepping followup chat for MTTR and followup actions. :thumbsup:
